crossRefs.note: In the first month, which is the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot…
Letters were sent by couriers into all the king’s provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews…
on one day in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.
Now in the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the month, when the king’s commandment and…
The Jews who were in Susa gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and killed three…
This was done on the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of that month they rested and made it…
Therefore the Jews of the villages, who live in the unwalled towns, make the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of…
to enjoin them that they should keep the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month Adar yearly,

people.name: Darius
people.line: Persian king who decreed the rebuilding of the Temple

translations.web: This house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
translations.bsb: And this temple was completed on the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.
